name: Pillar Hover Nav
description: Sticky top navbar whose links drop down as pillars on hover, with neighboring links following in a wave. Collapses to a plus-icon toggle with a slide-down menu on mobile.
contents: Sticky bar with text logo link
Row of equal-width links with arrow icons
Mobile plus toggle and slide-down link panel
behavior: Hovered link drops down and the next two links follow with smaller offsets
Below 768px links move into a panel opened by a rotating plus button
Links flagged ebook are hidden below the xl breakpoint
Bar stays stuck to the top of the page
editableByProps: Logo text and link, number of links, labels and hrefs
Bar, text, pillar and divider colors
